people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Jabesh
people.line: A town in Gilead, loyal to Saul

people.name: Nahash
people.line: Ammonite king who besieged Jabesh Gilead.

translations.web: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh Gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”
translations.bsb: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead. All the men of Jabesh said to him, “Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you.”
translations.kjv: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
